purpose: Document first-party Bangladesh cadastral/map discovery and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: The official DLRS settlement viewer and current MapSearch.js were reviewed. Anonymous endpoint discovery and bounded requests succeeded for division metadata, Pabna district metadata, BDS survey metadata, Pabna Sadar administrative/mouza metadata, and one sheet GeoJSON response. The tested sheet response was not shown to contain the exact WUP point, so no parcel polygon was retained.
registryAssessment: DLRS is the national Department of Land Records and Surveys; the Pabna Zonal Settlement Office is the evidenced local settlement/cadastral custodian for Pabna. This establishes local registry custody and a public map procedure, not citywide parcel-vector coverage.
safeFieldAllowlist: native Dag_No identity only if a sample is later retained

nativeFieldMapping.mappingDecision: No retained feature. FID/Id were not promoted because the tested sheet was not tied to the WUP point; Dag_No is the source-visible parcel/dag identity for any future qualified sample.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official DLRS map viewer. Page references /js/MapSearch.js and exposes survey/mouza/sheet/dag controls.
Official Pabna Zonal Settlement Office portal with Pabna/Sirajganj mouza-list and survey context.
Official Ministry of Land mouza-and-plot digital land-zoning project; describes digitized/georeferenced mouza map sheets.

searchQueries.query: Pabna Bangladesh official cadastral map land records parcel GIS
searchQueries.result: Official DLRS viewer, Smart Bhumi Naksha project, Pabna Zonal Settlement Office, and DLRS digital survey material found; no safe exact-point parcel match established.

searchQueries.query: পাবনা বাংলাদেশ সরকারি ক্যাডাস্ট্রাল মানচিত্র জমির রেকর্ড জিআইএস
searchQueries.result: Official Bengali DLRS/Ministry of Land sources found; Pabna district and Pabna Sadar BDS metadata returned from the public viewer, but no exact-point parcel match established.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: The exact WUP point was preserved as 24.0069361559384 latitude, 89.2376788585173 longitude. No point-shifted query was used. The tested sheet response was not demonstrated to cover that point.

requestEvidence.responseAssessment: 2.2 MB GeoJSON FeatureCollection; declared CRS EPSG:4326; parcel-like polygons and Dag_No fields observed. Full raw response remains only in ignored tmp/ scratch and was not retained as an artifact.

attempts.result: Anonymous division metadata returned; Rajshahi division code 030000000 identified.
Anonymous district metadata returned; Pabna district identified as unit 031100000 with comcod 4156.
Pabna returned BDS survey rsnum 201901, status চলমান (ongoing).
Pabna Sadar upazila returned with route unit 031101021 (Gafriabad mouza entry).
Anonymous mouza/sheet metadata returned for the Pabna Sadar route.
Bounded single-sheet GeoJSON response obtained and schema/CRS inspected; no safe city-qualified sample retained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official DLRS survey map service with Pabna district and Pabna Sadar BDS routes.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Anonymous metadata and one public GeoJSON sheet were verified; exact WUP-point inclusion and citywide completeness remain unknown.

remainingUncertainty: The public viewer requires selecting the correct mouza and sheet for the city point; the bounded route tested here returned a sheet whose extent was not established as Pabna city. BDS is marked ongoing, and no citywide parcel API or completeness statement was verified.
runtimeAssessment: held; serial reviewer must independently qualify any adapter
